title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 2 Clause 85 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 2 Clause 85 - Co-operative Society “Co-operative Society” means a co-operative society registered under the Co-operative Societies Act, 2001 (Act No. 47 of 2001), or any law for the time being in force relating to the registration of co-operative societies; Click here to see Bangla version Note: This is unofficial English translation. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail. Moreover, as per Section 345(2) of the Income Tax Act 2023, if there is a conflict between the English and Bengali text, the Bengali text shall prevail.
